description: Land Acquisition - Elections Commission - Declare that V.T.G.N. Prabhath as a member of the Sri Jayawardanapura Kotte Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a municipal council due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for a local government body, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new council member. This falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7), which covers electoral matters including candidate nominations, registrations, and declarations related to local authorities.
